description: What is RSO? RSO is one of the most potent and natural cannabis extracts available. Unlike refined oils, RSO keeps the full spectrum of compounds from the plant– THC, CBD, cannabinoids, terpenes, and flavinoids all working together for stronger, longer-lasting effects. Many people choose RSO for help with sleep, pain relief, and overall wellness. How to Use RSO With the Dablicator pen, using RSO has never been easier. Just twist and click to dispense a rice-grain-sized drop - no mess, no syringes, no guesswork. You can dispense directly onto a spoon to injest, add it to a smoothie or warm beverage, or add it to foods (like a cookie or cracker). It can also be disolved into butter or oil for cooking. How do I use Dablicator? Dablicator is easy to use! First, take the green cap off the tip. Then, holding the oil tank with one hand, twist the body of the dablicator– as the device twists, a dispensor button will extend from the bottom. There will be black lines at .025ml intervals and one red line at a .15ml interval. Each batch of RSO will have a different potency, so it is important to review the information on your product's label for exact dosing information. Once you’ve twisted to your desired dose, press the button to dispense the oil. When you’re done dispensing oil, just twist back on the body to stop the flow of oil. When you first use a new Dablicator, you will need to prime it by going through the above steps to use the device and push any residual air pockets out. Once you’ve cleared this air pocket, you’ll be able to use the Dablicator as described above. Visit headandhealthc.com for further instruction on how to use your Dablicator.
